expect.asks_about: Which person in the photo is the user: the bearded man on the left or the short-haired blonde woman on the right?

item.title: Choose The Right Headshot Subject

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this?

item.tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

answer_sheet.Which person: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and expression: Natural and professional; keep my smile.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: No particular platform; square, 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this pic? I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—**I haven’t run anything or spent any credits.** Which person is you: the person on the left or the right?

For a square professional headshot, here are the options:

| Option | Credit cost | What you get |
|---|---:|---|
| **Budget image edit** | **Listed from 5 credits** | One square image at 640px using the free-plan-compatible Flux 2 Klein model; change the background and clothing while aiming to preserve your likeness |
| Dedicated headshot tool | 50 credits | Specialized headshot generation; requires a source photo with only one detectable face |
| Crop only, outside Magic Hour | 0 Magic Hour credits | A square crop of the existing photo, without changing the beach background or outfit |

**I recommend the 640px budget edit.** It’s the lowest-listed-cost generation option here. Making a still image “shorter” doesn’t apply, and a smaller crop won’t reduce the listed generation price further.

Tell me which person to use and whether you approve the **5-credit option**. If the actual price can’t be confirmed as 5 credits, I’ll pause rather than run it.
dialog.user: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right. ok, go ahead with that—keep my smile natural and professional.

turns.agent:
Got it—the woman on the right, keeping your short blonde hair and natural smile, with square framing and a professional background.

**I haven’t started generation.** The tool lists Flux 2 Klein as **“from 5 credits,”** but the connected tools don’t provide an exact price check or a 5-credit spending cap. Since I promised to pause unless I could confirm that price, I can’t safely submit it within your approved limit.

The intended settings are **one 640px square image**—the cheapest listed generation option. You can check its exact credit quote in Magic Hour’s image editor before submitting.
